correctness.rationale: A complete infinite proof reduces periodic antisquare goodness to a finite forbidden set via the published minimal-antisquare theorem and its exceptional-factor proposition; the cyclic transition code yields unique minority-bit gaps, and cyclic block generation plus gap-vector double counting prove the bivariate zeta, exact coefficients and sharp support for every n. A standalone standard-library verifier independently matched all 131070 words through n=16, direct antisquares in all 4094 words through n=11, 40 transfer-matrix length spectra and support thresholds through n=120. Finite tests corroborate but do not certify infinite statements.

originality.rationale: The claim is the full Hamming-weight-refined periodic-point zeta series, its exact binomial coefficient formula and sharp positive-weight support (including the one-third density bound and parity boundary). Baranwal et al. provide the forbidden-pattern/Pansiot premise and total-growth information, while a prior unweighted periodic-point enumeration yields only the specialization at unit weight. Neither statement logically fixes the separate coefficients; the present proof derives them from unique background and gap composition. Exact topic/equivalence queries found no covering refinement; unindexed parallels remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: The complete constant-composition spectrum of a natural antisquare-avoidance shift is a meaningful invariant absent from simple total-growth or unweighted orbit enumeration: balanced compositions are impossible, the sharp positive-support boundary is 3r+(r mod 2), and all nonempty fibers have exact binomial multiplicities. This permits exact fixed-weight circular constrained-word selection for every length and shows an unexpected density gap with parity-dependent extremal attainment. The gain is structural and global, not merely a one-length numerical increment.
